goal: Single-task Enrollment requires a clean workspace apart from the Planner-produced intent and Spec, records its Enrollment HEAD, and takes the task's diff, attribution and changed paths from that HEAD, disclosing files beyond the estimate instead of refusing them (Spec branch-boundary-r2 D23).

acceptance.assertion: Enrollment refuses with workspace_not_clean naming the paths when a tracked file is modified or a non-ignored untracked file exists outside the task's own intent and Spec, and succeeds when only those planning files are dirty.

A single task's diff hash and changed paths cover the commits since its recorded enrollment_head plus its working-tree changes, and a file it changed outside scope_hint is settled and listed as beyond_estimate rather than refused.
